title: Principal spectral theory and variational characterizations for nonlocal coupled cooperative systems and applications
summary: This paper investigates the principal spectral theory of a nonlocal dispersal operator with coupled diffusion and aims to establish a variational characterization of the spectral bound for the case where the system is not strongly coupled. In this setting, a key difficulty arises since the principal eigenfunction may have components that are identically zero, rendering existing generalized eigenvalue methods inapplicable.
